video:video.video:title: Mike Has A Visitor: Original Psychological Horror Score - Sleep Paralysis Short
video:video.video:description: Sleep paralysis horror short scored by Zazie Kanwar-Torge. Dark, atmospheric, cinematic composition for psychological horror. Original score, themes, tension cues, and dread beds written to picture. Psychological horror composer showreel sample.

video:video.video:title: GOODBYE, BROTHER: Original Dark Cinematic Film Score - Psychological Drama
video:video.video:description: Dramatic short film scored by Zazie Kanwar-Torge. Atmospheric cinematic composition for dark psychological storytelling. Original themes and tension cues.

video:video.video:title: Home Intruder: Thriller Chase Cue - Tension-Driven Horror Composition
video:video.video:description: Action thriller chase sequence scored by Zazie Kanwar-Torge. Tension-driven cinematic composition for thriller and horror. Dark, propulsive, dread-filled cue architecture.

video:video.video:title: The Haunted: Horror Film Teaser Score - Supernatural Thriller
video:video.video:description: Official teaser for The Haunted by Crystal Fox Films. Original supernatural horror score by Zazie Kanwar-Torge. Atmospheric dread, dark ambient beds, and cinematic themes for supernatural thriller and haunted house horror.

video:video.video:title: AQUAPHOBIA: Short Horror Film Score - Folk and Body Horror
video:video.video:description: Short horror film AQUAPHOBIA scored by Zazie Kanwar-Torge. Dark atmospheric composition for folk horror and psychological dread. Waterphone, bowed metal, hybrid orchestration.

video:video.video:title: Whispers In The Dark: Horror Short Score - Atmospheric Dread Composition
video:video.video:description: Horror short Whispers In The Dark scored by Zazie Kanwar-Torge. Atmospheric dread composition for supernatural horror. Slow-burn tension beds and psychological horror architecture.

video:video.video:title: Phantom Requiem: Short Film Score - Gothic Horror
video:video.video:description: Short film Phantom Requiem scored by Zazie Kanwar-Torge. Dark cinematic composition for psychological horror and gothic dread. Original themes, motifs, atmospheric beds.

video:video.video:title: Eclipsed: Psychological Thriller Short - Unsettling Film Score
video:video.video:description: Psychological thriller short film scored by Zazie Kanwar-Torge. Experimental analog synthesis, prepared instruments, and psychoacoustic dread composition.
